requirements: Is there exactly one single full-body painting of Deedee and nothing else?
Is Deedee standing alone and facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle turned toward the left?
Is Deedee's head tipped slightly forward with eyes looking toward the left?
Are Deedee's hands loosely clasped in front at the waist?
Is Deedee's mouth closed in a small attentive smile?
Are Deedee's eyebrows a little raised?
Does Deedee's face, hair, build, age, clothes and colors exactly match the approved hero painting?
Does the figure fill about 85 percent of the picture height and is it centered?
Is there an even empty margin all around the figure?
